label: B25-UNCONSTRAINED-CLOCK-AUDIT
title: Classify reserved JTAG and EMIF reset unconstrained clocks
scope: Classify the two unconstrained clock targets and reserved JTAG I/O paths from T-002. Determine whether altera_reserved_tck/tdi/tms/tdo are vendor-dedicated paths needing a documented waiver or generated-IP constraint, and whether emif_rst_sync1_n is an async-control CDC requiring an SDC cut or RTL reset-architecture change. Do not invent an arbitrary JTAG clock period.
reads: JTAG-UART generated HDL/SDC/QIP and Catapult SDC
validation: Query pin/type/fanout/clock association for both unconstrained clocks and all reserved JTAG input/output paths.
Trace emif_rst_sync1_n to async control pins and recovery/removal checks; distinguish data/reset/control from a real generated clock.
Check generated vendor SDC ownership for altera_reserved_tck and reject arbitrary create_clock if the interface frequency is cable-dependent.
Return waiver/SDC-fix/RTL-fix with exact minimum future write regions and fail-closed validation.
acceptance: Every unconstrained row is classified with object-level evidence and a safe action; no source/database/board state change occurs.
resource: Any remote report-only query acquires gamepc; no synthesis/fitter, one quartus_sta process, unique runtime output.

integrator_review.decision: Use exact object/count waiver checking; never invent a cable-dependent JTAG clock and never false-path away EMIF reset recovery/removal.
